Expected result: Correct identity. The connected business, channel, and time zone match the intended destination.
Draft only. The first chat-created post exists as an unscheduled draft; nothing was accidentally published.
Reviewed content. No placeholders, invented claims, broken links, or unapproved media remain.
Real publication. The test post appears on the intended social profile at the correct time; its live link is recorded.
Correct trigger. A fresh tester comments GUIDE on the exact selected post and receives one opening DM.
No unintended continuation. A tester who does not interact receives no automatic guide follow-up or promotional sequence from this flow.
Working delivery. “Send the guide” produces the correct public link once, without requiring the owner’s login.
Nonmatching comment. A different tester’s ordinary comment does not trigger the GUIDE flow.
FAQ boundaries. Known facts are answered accurately; unknown prices, guarantees, and hostile instructions do not create invented commitments.
Human handoff. HELP reaches the monitored person, sends the configured notification, and pauses automation for that conversation.
Opt-out. STOP and Unsubscribe perform the configured opt-out. Other responders do not continue unexpectedly.
Messaging window. The system does not send an automated follow-up outside the allowed window.
No duplicate responders. Native replies, the fixed flow, and optional AI do not send conflicting answers.
Recovery is documented. You know where to inspect failures, reconnect an expired channel, pause each component, and check for duplicates before retrying.
Someone owns maintenance. A real person checks handoffs, failed posts, source changes, opt-outs, and plan usage on an agreed schedule.
